The merge arithmetic is wrong: the second task vector is computed against the already-modified `tmp` (`f2 - tmp`) instead of the unmodified base, so `out[X] = b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2 - b - λ(f1-b))` rather than the required `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b)`. This violates Required result step 2, which specifies both task vectors taken against `base[X]`, and is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about. The resulting merged tensors will differ from the reference by a factor proportional to λ²(f1-b), far exceeding the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance.
